notes.title: Educational material for the game
notes.notes:
We have decided to release the educational material to everyone intersted after a few requests for this, so it is more accessible than right now, where it was only for educators.  It can be found here: 
http://www.playinghistory.eu/uploads/PH2-Slavetrade.zip
